summary: Phase 2 PDF-guided restyle QA on the 4 requested mobile screens (Expo web preview @ 390x844). ALL FOUR RESTYLES PASS. (1) WALLET (/(tabs)/wallet): orange gradient hero card renders with 'TOTAL BIGCOIN BALANCE', ₿ glyph, big amount (bc-balance='127'), white tier pill (bc-tier='🥉 Bronze'), streak + 'Lifetime 127 BC' (bc-lifetime), and a milestone progress bar reading '373 BC to next milestone'; all text on the orange card is white and clearly readable. Tab row (Overview/Activity/Rewards/Badges/Refer) present and switches content; Scan to Pay / My Splits / Deals action buttons present; Rewards tab shows redeemable rewards (50/100/200 BC), Refer tab shows referrer-code. (2) GAMES (/(tabs)/games): Quick Games render as a 2-column rounded tile grid — Spin & Win (quick-game-spin), Music Trivia (quick-game-trivia), Guess the Lyric (quick-game-lyric), each with a colored icon chip on top, label and description. Tapping the Music Trivia tile routes to /games/trivia-game and the trivia screen loads with question & options. Featured Spin card (featured-spin-card) and Predict & Win card (predict-win-card) unchanged; BigCoin chip shows '127'; 'More games live now' list still renders (BigFM Lyric Hunt, BigFM Music Trivia). (3) PROFILE (/(tabs)/profile, tab label 'More'): tidy rows with rounded icon chips render — Edit Preferences, Billing & Plans, Notifications, Advertise on BigFM, Re-do Onboarding, Help & Support, About BigFM, Sign Out (orange), Delete Account (red). Tapping Edit Preferences opens the preferences editor (profile-prefs) with all chip grids (Languages/Genres/Eras/Moods/Activities/Home area/RJ personality/Explicit) and the SAVE PREFERENCES button (save-prefs-btn). (4) NEARBY DEALS (/coupons): title reads 'Nearby Deals', subheader present, category filter chips (All/Food/Drinks/Entertainment/Wellness/Shopping) work — 'Food' filter correctly hides the non-food demo offer. The one seeded offer card shows a prominent orange '50% OFF' tile on the left plus category tag, title, description, expiry, inventory ('100 left'), terms, and a full-width orange 'Save coupon' CTA. Claiming the offer decremented inventory 100→99 (persistence confirmed). 'My Coupons' link navigates back to the Wallet screen. REGRESSION: bottom tab bar order is now correct — 'Home · Listen · Games · Wallet · More' (iter 33 tab-order bug is FIXED); warm cream+orange theme intact across all four screens; no crashes navigating between tabs.

issues: Minor: the offer-type text ('percent off') renders in lowercase with a leading space because it is derived from o.offer_type.replace(/_/g,' ') without capitalization — cosmetically inconsistent with the surrounding UI which uses uppercase labels. Cosmetic only, not blocking.
Minor: the 'trending' source badge and the 'percent off' tag share the same row and both use small type + orange tint — slight visual competition but readable.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) In /app/mobile/app/coupons.tsx around line 103, capitalize/normalize the offer_type label so 'percent_off' renders as 'Percent Off' (or hide it when the discount tile already shows the % value) — small readability polish.
(Optional/tech-debt) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow across wallet.tsx / games.tsx / coupons.tsx to silence React Native web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.tsx (505 lines) is bordering on the >700 threshold but still readable; consider splitting the sub-tab renderers (OverviewTab / BalanceTab / RewardsTab / BadgesTab / ReferTab) into files under src/components/wallet/ if it keeps growing.
In coupons.tsx `discountTile` uses `alignSelf: 'flex-start'` which correctly keeps the tile from stretching, and `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` on the info column is correctly set to prevent overflow — good.

In games.tsx the third quick tile occupies a single row of its own (only 3 tiles across 2 columns) which matches the PDF; `flexGrow: 1` on the tile means when it's alone on the second row it stretches full width — this is intentional and looks OK visually.
